reason: The core of T8 matches the pre-registered rules. safetail_ci admits CI files only when L_hi <= 10.75 h (CONTEXT l.3134, finals V_pub l.3179). Freeze (1) at l.4187 says L_hi > 10.75 h gives '?' at any display. The card pool rule (finals_card_v5_ru.md l.17 and step 3) agrees. 09:00:17Z + 10.75 h = 19:45:17Z (22:45 MSK) is correct, and V_pub staying exp87a 56640366 with pair П3 {exp87a, #37 56563521} is the conservative running-champion reading. Swapping in a late >= 0.960 read would be post-hoc. The row has two fixable defects. (1) It computes L_hi only from the poll header (+210 s x F). GAP RULE v2 (4) (l.4017) and card step 3 require tightening L_hi first from the e10_watch LB snapshots (the first snapshot where our SubmissionCount goes 56 -> 57; cadence ~30 min). If headers lag or fail, a file with a snapshot at <= 19:45:17Z could be wrongly coded '?' and a legitimate new V_pub lost. (2) The push ends with 'ничего не меняйте' but has no SELECTED-variant append. T0 requires a read-only SELECTED call before any message, and T4-T6 append (a)/(b)/(c). If SELECTED is {#37, #38} or 1/2, that advice is wrong.
fix: Trigger T8 only when L_hi, AFTER the e10_watch tightening, is > 10.75 h, i.e. min(first terminal header + 210 s x F, first e10_watch snapshot with our SubmissionCount 56 -> 57) - 09:00:17Z > 10.75 h. The snapshot tightens L_hi only if no other file of ours could complete in that window (slot 2 unused, or the other file still PENDING in that header). Make the one read-only SELECTED call first and append the variant as in T4: (a) 'ничего менять не нужно'; (b) 'у вас П2 {exp87a 56640366, exp75 56656157} — допустимый обмен, менять не обязательно'; (c) 'снимите #38 56563534, отметьте exp87a 56640366, проверьте «2 of 2 selected» до 23:00 МСК (20:00 UTC)' (after 20:00Z: '... до 02:59 МСК (23:59 UTC)'). Replace the unconditional 'ничего не меняйте' with this append. Keep the rest of the text as written.
realistic_gain: No direct LB or private gain. This is a procedural guard: it blocks a post-hoc swap to a late file and, with the tightening fix, avoids wrongly dropping an in-window exp89t read (a rare case: it needs header lag near 19:45Z and a read of >= 0.960 or 0.959 with UP, maybe ~0.001 on public if it happens).
